# Optics and photonics

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_prompts.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Open only the cards whose "Applies when" line matches the paper. Paths are relative to this folder; the index of all folders is [../../INDEX.md](../../INDEX.md).

| Id | Card | Applies when |
|---|---|---|
| T-CAVITY-OPTOMECHANICS | [Cavity optomechanics](cavity-optomechanics.md) | the paper couples a mechanical mode to an optical or microwave cavity and reports a vacuum coupling rate, cooperativity, sideband cooling, a phonon occupancy or ground-state claim, motional sideband asymmetry, optomechanical thermometry, or the effect of laser or thermal noise on the mechanical mode |
| CL-OPTOELECTRONIC-EFFICIENCY | [Claims of optoelectronic device efficiency](optoelectronic-efficiency.md) | the paper claims a record, certified or high power conversion efficiency (PCE) for a solar cell, or a high external quantum efficiency (EQE) or efficacy for a light-emitting diode (LED), or ranks such efficiencies against reported values |
| T-INTEGRATED-PHOTONICS | [Integrated photonics](integrated-photonics.md) | the paper reports waveguide propagation loss, resonator quality factors, fibre-to-chip coupling or insertion loss, device footprint, fabrication yield or variation, or modulator figures of merit such as half-wave voltage, bandwidth, extinction ratio or energy per bit for a photonic integrated circuit |
| T-LASER-CHARACTERIZATION | [Laser characterization](laser-characterization.md) | the paper claims lasing, or reports a laser's threshold, output power or efficiency, linewidth, frequency or phase noise, beam quality or M², or power or frequency stability, including claims of lasing from new gain materials, microcavities or nanolasers |
| T-METASURFACES | [Metamaterials and metasurfaces](metasurfaces.md) | the paper reports a metamaterial or metasurface device such as a metalens, beam deflector or hologram, quotes its efficiency, bandwidth or field of view, or assigns an effective permittivity, permeability or refractive index, including a negative index, to a structured medium |
| T-MICRORESONATOR-COMBS | [Microresonators and frequency combs](microresonator-combs.md) | the paper reports the quality factor or linewidth of an optical microresonator, or generates a Kerr frequency comb or soliton microcomb and claims a soliton state, coherence, low noise, stabilisation, self-referencing, conversion efficiency, parametric threshold or thermal behaviour |
| T-NONLINEAR-OPTICS | [Nonlinear optics and frequency conversion](nonlinear-optics.md) | the paper reports harmonic generation, sum- or difference-frequency generation, parametric amplification or oscillation, or a measured nonlinear coefficient such as d, χ(2), χ(3), n2 or two-photon absorption, or bases a claim on conversion efficiency, phase matching or power handling |
| T-FIBRE-OPTICS | [Optical fibres, fibre lasers and amplifiers](fibre-optics.md) | the paper measures fibre loss, dispersion or a nonlinear threshold, reports amplifier gain or noise figure, reports the output power, beam quality or mode instability of a fibre laser or amplifier, or bases a capacity or reach claim on a fibre transmission experiment |
| T-PHOTODETECTORS | [Photodetectors](photodetectors.md) | the paper reports responsivity, external quantum efficiency, gain, noise-equivalent power, specific detectivity, response time, bandwidth or linear dynamic range of a light detector, or bases a claim of high sensitivity, broadband or fast detection on them |
| T-PLASMONICS | [Plasmonics and nanophotonics](plasmonics.md) | the paper reports surface-enhanced Raman or other near-field enhancement factors, simulated plasmonic field enhancement, single-molecule detection by enhanced spectroscopy, plasmonic heating or hot-carrier effects, single-nanoparticle optical spectra, or near-field optical microscopy images or spectra |
| T-NONCLASSICAL-LIGHT | [Squeezed and non-classical light](nonclassical-light.md) | the paper reports quadrature squeezing or anti-squeezing in dB, balanced homodyne measurements, sub-Poissonian or sub-shot-noise light, a Fano factor or Mandel Q parameter, or a Wigner function or density matrix of an optical mode reconstructed from homodyne or photon-counting data |
| T-COMPUTATIONAL-IMAGING | [Super-resolution and computational imaging](computational-imaging.md) | the paper bases images on phase retrieval, regularised or learned reconstruction, or imaging through or inside scattering media, or claims a resolution gain by computational or label-free means; localisation, STED, SIM and expansion microscopy have their own card |
| CL-TOPOLOGICAL-PHOTONICS | [Topological photonics](topological-photonics.md) | the paper claims topological edge, interface or corner modes in a photonic, polariton or other classical-wave structure, attributes robust or backscattering-free light transport to topology, reports a photonic topological invariant, or claims topological lasing |
| T-PULSE-CHARACTERIZATION | [Ultrafast pulse characterization](pulse-characterization.md) | the paper reports an ultrashort pulse duration, chirp, spectral phase or temporal shape, measures pulses by autocorrelation, frequency-resolved optical gating, spectral interferometry, SPIDER or a related method, or bases a claim on pulse compression or a pulse-derived peak intensity |
